user.title: Japan Parcel Tracker
user.description: Pick the to-do list where you'll add tracking numbers (one per item, e.g. `Headphones 1111-2222-3333`). The carrier is detected automatically; prefix with `sagawa:`, `yamato:`, `jp:` or `ali:` to force one. Tip: create a dedicated list first under Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → Local To-do.
